data.description: This spell functions as lesser entice fey, except the spell's whimsical calling can produce a single fey of 18 Hit Dice or less, or up to three fey of the same kind whose Hit Dice total no more than 18. This spell functions as lesser entice fey, except the spell's whimsical calling can produce a single fey of 18 Hit Dice or less, or up to three fey of the same kind whose Hit Dice total no more than 18. Material components include offerings worth 2500 gp plus payment.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
Up to three called fey, totaling no more than 18 Hit Dice, no two of which can appear more than 30 ft. apart
